title: Generic function types can't be used as type parameter bounds.
summary: Try making the free variable in the function type part of the larger declaration signature.
message_templates: Generic function types can't be used as type parameter bounds.

title: A generic function type can't be a type argument.
summary: Try removing type parameters from the generic function type, or using 'dynamic' as the type argument here.
message_templates: A generic function type can't be a type argument.

title: A method tear-off on a receiver whose type is 'dynamic' can't have type arguments.
summary: Specify the type of the receiver, or remove the type arguments from the method tear-off.
message_templates: A method tear-off on a receiver whose type is 'dynamic' can't have type arguments.

title: The class '…' can't extend 'Struct' or 'Union' because '…' is generic.
summary: Try removing the type parameters from '…'.
message_templates: The class '{}' can't extend 'Struct' or 'Union' because '{}' is generic.

title: Getters can't be defined within methods or functions.
summary: Try moving the getter outside the method or function, or converting the getter to a function.
message_templates: Getters can't be defined within methods or functions.

title: The return type of getter '…' is '…' which isn't a subtype of the type '…' of its setter '…'.
summary: Try changing the types so that they are compatible.
message_templates: The return type of getter '{}' is '{}' which isn't a subtype of the type '{}' of its setter '{}'.

title: Getters must be declared without a parameter list.
summary: Try removing the parameter list, or removing the keyword 'get' to define a method rather than a getter.
message_templates: Getters must be declared without a parameter list.
